h1: The 8 Best 3-Drawer Nightstands of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 8 best 3-drawer nightstands, with charging ports, LED lighting, and footprint compared for small bedrooms and dorms.
summary: The Huuger 3-drawer rustic brown nightstand is the best 3-drawer nightstand: a slim 15.7 inch frame, a USB-C port, two AC outlets and an open shelf for $25 to $50. The Yoobure is the FCC and ETL certified pick, and the SONGMICS BELLAH has the most ports at five. The WLIVE has the deepest drawers and a 110 lb rating.
intro: Plenty of buyers choose a three-drawer nightstand by color and photographs, then notice later that the height does not match the mattress. A table that sits four inches under the bed top means reaching down for the phone every night. One that stands much taller crowds a reading lamp and puts your alarm clock at eye level when you are lying down.

We reviewed eight models on paper, comparing dimensions, materials, charging ports and weight capacity. Charging and LED lighting come bundled in most of them, so the ranking weighs build and footprint alongside the electronics. Heights run from about 23.6 to 29.9 inches across the group, a spread of over six inches that decides which beds each one suits, so height deserves a tape measure before checkout.

products.name: Huuger 3-Drawer Rustic Brown Nightstand with USB-C
products.verdict: Slim 15.7 inch frame with USB-C and an open shelf.
products.description:
The Huuger measures 15.7 by 11.8 by 27.6 inches and uses P2 particleboard with a powder-coated steel frame. It has three fabric drawers plus an open shelf, two AC outlets, one USB-A and one USB-C port, and a stain-resistant top. It sells for $25 to $50. A slim 15.7 inch width fits beside a bed in a small room without blocking the walkway.

It leads the group because it combines that slim footprint with a USB-C port, which several cheaper rivals skip. Against the SONGMICS, it gives up two charging ports but stands shorter at 27.6 inches. The open shelf keeps a lamp or book off the drawer tops.

Buy it for a small bedroom that needs a balanced bedside table. The caveat is the particleboard build, which will not match solid wood durability, and fabric drawers that sag over time. Skip it if you want solid wood or a deeper drawer.
pros: Open shelf for a lamp or book
products.idealFor: Small bedrooms needing a charging nightstand.
products.skipIf: You want solid wood or a deeper drawer.

products.name: Yoobure 3-Drawer White Nightstand with 16-Color LED, FCC & ETL Certified
products.verdict: FCC and ETL certified electrical components.
products.description:
Yoobure's nightstand measures 15.4 by 11.8 by 25.6 inches, built from wood board, a metal frame and fabric drawers. The electrical components are FCC and ETL certified, with two AC outlets and two USB ports, and 16 RGB colors in 22 modes via app or remote. An X-bar support frame and adjustable feet help stability. It sells for $25 to $50. ETL marking means a lab assessed the wiring.

Second place goes to the certification, which none of the other models list, though it has no USB-C port like the Huuger. Against the SONGMICS, it trades two ports and 4 inches of height for certified electronics and level feet.

Choose it if electrical safety matters most, or your floors are uneven. The caveat is the shorter 25.6 inch height. Skip it if you want a taller table or USB-C.
products.skipIf: You want a taller table or USB-C.

products.name: SONGMICS BELLAH 3-Drawer White Nightstand with 5 Charging Ports
products.verdict: Five charging ports and a 66 lb capacity.
products.description:
The SONGMICS BELLAH stands 29.9 inches tall, the tallest here, at 15.6 by 11.8 inches. It mixes particleboard, steel and PVC leather, with three drawers and an open shelf. Charging gives two AC, two USB-A and one USB-C, five ports in total. App-controlled LED music sync, an anti-tip kit and a 66 lb capacity complete it at $25 to $50. A stated weight rating is rare in this group.

It beats the Huuger on port count and capacity but costs you height, which suits raised beds only. Against the Lazzanto, it lists a higher capacity, 66 lb against 50, for a lower price tier.

Best for a tall bed with several devices. The caveat is that 29.9 inches can look oversize on a low platform bed. Skip it if you have a low platform bed.
products.idealFor: Raised beds and heavy device users.
products.skipIf: You have a low platform bed.

products.name: Furnulem 3-Drawer Rustic Brown Nightstand with 3-Way Charging Install
products.verdict: The charging unit can be installed three ways.
products.description:
The Furnulem is 15.74 by 11.5 by 28.3 inches in particleboard with a metal frame and three fabric drawers. It offers two AC outlets and two USB ports, and the charging unit can be installed in three positions. An anti-toppling device is included. It sells for $25 to $50. Install flexibility lets you put the cord where your outlet is, not where the maker decided.

It trails the Huuger because it lists no USB-C port and no open shelf, but flexible charging placement helps when your wall outlet is in an awkward spot. Against the Yoobure, it adds a toppling guard and a taller body.

Buy it if outlet position is tricky. The caveat is the lack of USB-C. Skip it if you want USB-C charging for a modern phone.

products.name: Lazzanto 3-Drawer Black Nightstand with Voice-Sync LED
products.verdict: The most advanced LED controls in the guide.
products.description:
The Lazzanto in black measures 15.6 by 11.4 by 29.4 inches, with a particleboard and metal frame, three fabric drawers, and a water-resistant top with rounded corners. It has two AC and two USB ports, plus LED voice, app, timer and music sync, and a 50 lb capacity. It sells for $50 to $100. Rounded corners are a plus around kids and in dark bedrooms.

It costs more than the Huuger, with the extra money going to lighting rather than build. Against the SONGMICS, it adds voice control for the LED but lists a lower weight rating and no USB-C.

Choose it if LED effects matter. The caveat is the higher price tier for features you may not use. Skip it if you just want charging and storage.
products.skipIf: You just want charging and storage.

products.name: Lazzanto 3-Drawer White Nightstand with Voice-Sync LED
products.verdict: The same smart LED unit as the black version, in white.
products.description:
The white Lazzanto has the same 15.6 by 11.4 by 29.4 inch frame, three fabric drawers, water-resistant top and two AC plus two USB ports with voice, app, timer and music sync LEDs. The capacity is 50 lbs and it sells for $50 to $100. A white finish brightens a small bedroom and shows less dust than black.

It ranks just under the black version only because it is a color variant, offering nothing new in features. The tradeoffs against the Huuger are the same: more lighting, less build value, and no USB-C. White scuffs show faster than black.

Pick it if white matches your room. The caveat is that it repeats the black model's specs. Skip it if you prefer black or do not want LEDs.
products.idealFor: White bedroom schemes with smart lighting.
products.skipIf: You prefer black or do not want LEDs.

products.name: WLIVE Tall 3-Drawer Espresso Nightstand, 22.99" Wide
products.verdict: Roomiest drawers and a 110 lb capacity, but wide.
products.description:
The WLIVE measures 22.99 by 15.59 by 29.06 inches, the widest here, in engineered wood. It has three drawers with a 13.78 inch depth, the deepest, plus two AC and two USB ports, a waterproof top, smooth metal glides, and a 110 lb capacity, the highest. It sells for $50 to $100. Metal glides bear more weight than fabric and run smoother.

It sits lower because the 22.99 inch width is hard to fit in a small bedroom. Against the SONGMICS, its capacity is 44 lb higher, 110 against 66, and the drawers are far deeper. Against the Huuger set, it is a single table with one-off value.

Buy it if storage matters more than space. The caveat is the footprint, which crowds a walkway. Skip it if your room is small.
products.idealFor: Bedrooms with space and lots to store.

products.name: Huuger Paint 3-Drawer White Nightstand Set of 2
products.verdict: A matching pair with the most premium finish listed.
products.description:
This is a set of two Huuger tables, each 23.62 by 15.75 by 23.62 inches, made of engineered wood, painted smooth, with reinforced side panels. Every table gets three deep drawers and a mix of two AC, one USB-A and one USB-C port. It sells for $200 to $500 for the pair. A matching set looks deliberate in a bedroom with two sleepers.

It ranks last because of the price and the wide, low shape, though per table the cost is less alarming. Against the single Huuger, it stands four inches lower and gives up the open shelf. It is also the only set that comes as a pair.

Buy it for symmetrical bedsides. The caveat is the wide footprint and the highest total cost. Skip it if you only need one nightstand.

whatMatters.detail: A nightstand should sit within a few inches of the mattress top so you reach items without bending. Heights here run from 23.62 to 29.9 inches. Measure your mattress top and compare it to the listed height. The Huuger pair is the lowest and the BELLAH the tallest. Remember to include any topper in the mattress height.

Width and depth decide whether it fits beside the bed without blocking a walkway. Most picks are about 15.6 inches wide, while the WLIVE is nearly 23. Check width in the title or dimensions. A narrow table leaves room for a lamp base and a cable, and a wide one needs a clear path to the bed edge.

Ports include AC outlets, USB-A and USB-C. USB-C matters for modern phones and tablets. Count ports in the bullets and check for USB-C, which the Huuger, SONGMICS and the pair list. Several others, like the Yoobure and Furnulem, skip it. Five ports on the BELLAH suit a couple sharing a table, and a USB-C port future-proofs the purchase.

A tall narrow table can tip, especially with kids or pets. Anti-tip kits and adjustable feet help. Look for anti-tip or anti-toppling on the listing, as on the SONGMICS and Furnulem, and anchor the table to the wall if children share the room. Adjustable feet, as on the Yoobure, steady a table on uneven floors, which keeps drawers from drifting open.

Fabric drawers are light but can sag, while metal glides run smoothly on bigger drawers. Weight capacity ranges from 50 to 110 lbs. Check the stated capacity and drawer material. The WLIVE lists 110 lb and metal glides, the Lazzanto 50 lb, and several others list no rating, so do not stack heavy books on a drawerless top.

faq.q: Will these fit in a dorm room?
faq.a: The 15 inch wide models should fit beside a standard twin bed. Check your wall outlet position first, and note that a wide WLIVE needs more room. A twin bed leaves little space beside it.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake with nightstands?
faq.a: Ignoring bed height. A table well below the mattress top is awkward to use, so measure first and pick the Huuger for average beds or the BELLAH for raised ones. Two inches of mismatch is the limit of comfort.

faq.q: Is the SONGMICS worth it over the Huuger?
faq.a: Only if you need five ports and a taller body. The Huuger is shorter and still has USB-C. The SONGMICS also lists a 66 lb capacity and an anti-tip kit, while the Huuger offers the open shelf. Decide which matters more.

Follow the manual, install the anti-tip kit if provided, and plug the charging unit into a wall outlet. Use adjustable feet if your floor is uneven, as on the Yoobure. Check each drawer slides freely before loading.

faq.q: How do I care for the top?
faq.a: Wipe with a damp cloth. Several tops are listed as stain or water resistant, such as the Huuger and WLIVE, but wipe spills quickly to protect the finish. Avoid abrasive cleaners on painted or leather-look trim.

faq.q: Can I use it as a desk side table?
faq.a: Yes, but check height against your desk. Wide models like the WLIVE need more room, and the 23.62 inch Huuger pair sits low enough for most desks. Check the outlet reach before placing it.

finalTake: Buy the Huuger for a small bedroom that needs a charging nightstand with USB-C. Choose the Yoobure when certified wiring matters, the SONGMICS for a raised bed and many devices, and the Furnulem for awkward outlets. The WLIVE suits a big bedroom with lots to store, and the Huuger pair matching bedsides. Match the height to your mattress before the features.
